name: @ariada-org/circleci-orb
description: CircleCI orb source for the Ariada differential accessibility gate.

scripts.lint: ruby -e 'require "yaml"; ARGV.each { |f| YAML.load_stream(File.read(f)); puts "ok #{f}" }' src/orb.yml examples/config.yml
scripts.test: grep -q 'ariada diff classify' src/orb.yml && grep -q 'ariada diff gate' src/orb.yml
